descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S23 Existing specs: exactly two versioned Bedrock model IDs are invocable, the default is dated Haiku 4.5, and IAM matches

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on. (UAT OAT-05; UAT 3.1; TFA-94059 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given providers.spec.ts (no backend needed)

When Resolve the default model and a model just outside the allowed set (Sonnet or Opus IDs), and compare the IAM policy's model list with ALLOWED_MODELS

Then The default is us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0. Only that and mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct resolve; the others throw 'is not allowed'. The IAM policy allows exactly the same set.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. This is the code half of step 7's 'model ID version-pinned'. Production is S19.

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S23

Existing specs: exactly two versioned Bedrock model IDs are invocable, the default is dated Haiku 4.5, and IAM matches

Tickets: TFA-94059 Security & compliance gating before real PHI (credentials + BAAs) (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-05.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — defaults text generation to Bedrock with Claude Haiku 4.5 — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — only Mistral Large 3 and Claude Haiku 4.5 are invocable on Bedrock — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — the IAM policy allows exactly the models the app allows — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/providers.spec.ts): it checks convex/ai/providers/models.ts and infra/stacks/aws.ts in-process from the QA worktree and calls no deployment, so there is nothing to run on dev; it runs with the local suite (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):
